location_change.notes_base: Book on 12306.cn or Trip.com. Departs Beijing North (not Beijing South). Recommend early morning departure to maximize time at Yungang Grottoes. Book at least 2 weeks in advance during Golden Week period (Labour Day holiday). Both Matilde and Jade travel together.
location_change.notes_local: 在12306.cn或携程订票。从北京北站出发（非北京南站）。建议尽早出发以充分游览云冈石窟。劳动节假期期间建议提前至少两周购票。Matilde和Jade同行。

datong_to_beijing_evening.name_local: 大同 → 北京（傍晚返程）
datong_to_beijing_evening.notes_base: Both Matilde and Jade return to Beijing in the evening after visiting Hanging Monastery. Depart Datong South ~17:37, arrive Beijing North ~20:28 (171 min). Book together with Day 3 outbound ticket on 12306.cn.
datong_to_beijing_evening.notes_local: Matilde和Jade傍晚参观悬空寺后一同返京。大同南站约17:37出发，约20:28抵达北京北站（171分钟）。与第3天出发票一同在12306.cn购买。

location_change.arrival_point_base: Chengdu Tianfu International Airport (TFU) or Shuangliu (CTU)
location_change.arrival_point_local: 成都天府国际机场（TFU）或双流（CTU）
location_change.notes_base: Matilde only - Jade has class in Beijing. Morning flight 07:45-10:25 (approx 160 min). Alternative options: 13:30 flight (arr 16:15) if morning feels rushed. Price EUR 301 per person (~CNY 2380 / USD 328). Allow 2h airport transfer time. Taxi/express train to airport from city center takes ~1h. Book via Trip.com or airline website. HSR Beijing-Chengdu would take ~10h+ (not recommended). Price is approximate based on Duffel search April 2026.
location_change.notes_local: 仅Matilde搭乘——Jade在北京上课。早班机07:45-10:25（约160分钟）。如早晨时间紧，可选13:30航班（16:15抵达）。票价约301欧元/人（约2380元人民币/328美元）。请预留2小时机场中转时间。市区至机场约需1小时（出租车/机场快线）。可通过携程或航空公司官网购票。

jade_beijing_to_chengdu.name_local: 北京 → 成都（Jade，第6天早晨）
jade_beijing_to_chengdu.notes_base: Jade flies Beijing to Chengdu on May 7 (Day 6) to rejoin Matilde. Morning flight 07:45 recommended to arrive in time for Leshan Giant Buddha day trip. Same route as Matilde's May 6 flight. Book separately as it is a different date. EUR 301 per person (~USD 328). Allow 2h before departure for airport check-in.
jade_beijing_to_chengdu.notes_local: Jade于5月7日（第6天）从北京飞往成都与Matilde会合。推荐早班机07:45出发，可赶上乐山大佛一日游。与Matilde的5月6日航班为同一航线，需单独购票（日期不同）。票价约301欧元/人（约328美元）。请提前2小时到达机场办理值机。

jade_chengdu_to_beijing.name_base: Chengdu to Beijing (Jade return for class)
jade_chengdu_to_beijing.name_local: 成都 → 北京（Jade返京上课）
jade_chengdu_to_beijing.notes_base: Jade returns to Beijing on May 9 for class (May 9 class day). Flight 3U8893 dep 16:30 arr 19:00 (150 min). Alternative: earlier 3U8895 dep 18:00 or 3U8899 dep 20:30 if morning panda base visit runs late. EUR 301 per person (~USD 328). Matilde stays in Chengdu for panda base visit.
jade_chengdu_to_beijing.notes_local: Jade于5月9日（上课日）返京。推荐3U8893航班16:30出发、19:00抵达（150分钟）。若上午大熊猫基地行程延误，可改乘18:00（3U8895）或20:30（3U8899）航班。票价约301欧元/人（约328美元）。Matilde留在成都参观大熊猫繁育研究基地。

location_change.notes_base: Matilde only (Jade does not visit Xi'an). Chengdu-Xi'an HSR (opened 2020) takes approximately 3h30min-4h. Train G82 departs Chengdu East 08:55, arrives Xi'an North ~12:28 (213 min, second class ~CNY 234). Alternative: G308 dep 07:40, arr 11:04. Book on 12306.cn. Xi'an North Station is ~30 min by metro/taxi from city center. Note: Gaode Maps route showed connecting train D974 - recommend booking direct G-train on 12306 instead.
location_change.notes_local: 仅Matilde乘坐（Jade不去西安）。成渝至西安高铁（2020年开通）约需3.5-4小时。推荐G82次列车，成都东站08:55发车，约12:28抵达西安北站（213分钟，二等座约234元）。备选：G308次07:40出发，11:04抵达。请在12306.cn购票。西安北站距市中心约30分钟（地铁/出租车）。

location_change.name_base: Xi'an to Shanghai (Matilde) / Beijing to Shanghai (Jade)
location_change.name_local: 西安→上海（Matilde）/ 北京→上海（Jade）
location_change.type_local: 国内航班（两段独立航班）
location_change.company_base: China Southern Airlines (Matilde) / China Eastern Airlines (Jade)
location_change.company_local: 南方航空（Matilde）/ 东方航空（Jade）
location_change.departure_point_base: Xi'an Xianyang Airport (XIY) for Matilde; Beijing Capital Airport (PEK) for Jade
location_change.departure_point_local: 西安咸阳国际机场（XIY，Matilde）；北京首都国际机场（PEK，Jade）
location_change.arrival_point_base: Shanghai Pudong Airport (PVG) for Matilde; Shanghai Hongqiao Airport (SHA) for Jade
location_change.arrival_point_local: 上海浦东国际机场（PVG，Matilde）；上海虹桥机场（SHA，Jade）
location_change.notes_base: Two separate flights converging on Shanghai. MATILDE: CZ5792 XIY->PVG dep 10:30 arr 13:05 (155 min), EUR 135/person (~USD 147). Budget pick: 3U3269 dep 17:20 arr 19:50 at EUR 121 (~USD 132) if afternoon arrival preferred. JADE: MU5154 PEK->SHA dep 11:30 arr 13:35 (125 min), EUR 275/person (~USD 300). Coordinate arrival times so both reach the Bund area before evening. Note: Matilde at PVG, Jade at SHA - different airports, ~45min apart by taxi. Agree meeting point in central Shanghai.
location_change.notes_local: 两段独立航班在上海会合。Matilde：CZ5792 西安-浦东，10:30出发，13:05到达（155分钟），约135欧元/人（约147美元）。如需下午到达可选3U3269，17:20出发，19:50抵达（121欧元/约132美元）。Jade：MU5154 北京-虹桥，11:30出发，13:35到达（125分钟），约275欧元/人（约300美元）。注意：Matilde在浦东，Jade在虹桥，两机场相距约45分钟车程，请提前约定市区会合地点。

location_change.notes_base: Both Matilde and Jade travel together. Fuxing Hao high-speed train, one of China's fastest (350 km/h). G44 dep Shanghai Hongqiao 09:00, arr Beijing South ~13:28 (268 min, ~CNY 553 second class per person). Arrive Beijing by early afternoon, leaving time for Forbidden City / Temple of Heaven and evening Michelin dinner. Book on 12306.cn at least 2-3 weeks in advance - very popular route. Alternative: G2 dep 09:00 or other G trains on the same corridor.
location_change.notes_local: Matilde和Jade同行。复兴号高铁，最高时速350公里。G44次09:00上海虹桥出发，约13:28抵达北京南站（268分钟，二等座约553元/人）。午后抵京，可游览故宫/天坛，晚上享用米其林餐厅晚餐。建议提前2-3周在12306.cn购票，此线路极为热门。
